message.text:
**Considering shell commands**

I'm exploring using shell globbing with the globstar option enabled. I want to run a command like `shopt -s globstar; printf '%s\0' internal/**/*.go`, and I’m thinking about how Perl would read `@ARGV` to include all sources matching `**/*.go`. It's important that the shell globbing skips the .git directory too. I’m also considering that I might need to check the argument limits, possibly keeping it under 1K for performance.

args.command: shopt -s globstar nullglob; internal_files=(internal/**/*.go); NINT=${#internal_files[@]} perl -e '@i=@ARGV[0..$ENV{NINT}-1]; @a=@ARGV; for $p (@a) { open F,"<",$p; local $/; $all.=<F>; close F } for $p (@i) { open F,"<",$p; local $/; $s=<F>; close F; ($pkg)=$s =~ /^package\s+(\w+)/m; while($s =~ /^func\s+(?:\([^)]*\)\s+)?(\w+)\s*\(/mg) { $n=$1; $c=()=$all =~ /(?<!func\s)(?<!\w)\Q$n\E\s*\(/g; push @r, [$c-1,"$pkg.$n",$p] } } for (sort {$b->[0]<=>$a->[0]} @r) { print "$$_[0] $$_[1] $$_[2]\n" }' "${internal_files[@]}" **/*.go
